Question: Distinct lines \(\ell\) and \(m\) lie in the \(xy\)-plane. They intersect at the origin. Point \(P(-1, 4)\) is reflected about line \(\ell\) to point \(P',\) and then \(P'\) is reflected about line \(m\) to point \(P''.\) The equation of line \(\ell\) is \(5x - y = 0,\) and the coordinates of \(P''\) are \((4,1).\) What is the equation of line \(m?\)
